changes.body:
The compiled `scent` executable supplies Claude Code and Codex native hook protocols and
exports a self-contained Node-compatible Pi extension for Beeswax's loader. Pi runs that
module inside its own host. Identity delivery needs no Hive source checkout, application
dependencies or Bun on the harness PATH. Existing identity semantics and
selected-tracker preservation remain unchanged. Scent now provides its own offline
`changelog` command and release history; the source hook entry points and optional Codex
plugin are removed.

Required: install Scent with the matching Hive suite and use Beeswax's harness
selections to generate repository integration. Remove old source hooks, explicit Pi
Scent extension registrations and the optional Codex Scent plugin wherever present
before loading the generated adapters. Run `beeswax update --yes` in each adopting
checkout, review and commit the generated files, then restart and trust the native hooks
or extensions.
